lines: Shikanosuke, this is our chance!! Use that Jutsu!!
We had been confronted with these monsters once in the ruins of the mines, so I knew how to handle them.
The Devil Worm writhed in agony from the shock the static electricity caused to the surface of its body.
Alright!! Next up are those things!! I'm counting on you, Yamata no Orochi!!
Hm-hm... You're pretty good, Fuma kid. I like those orders of yours!
Yamata no Orochi leapt towards the swarm of Devildomian Wasps who had lost their leadership with the Devil Worm going into a frenzy.
The giant bee-like demonic beasts were smashed one after the other by the iron sword brandished by the female warrior.
Just seeing her display of tremendous power sent a shiver down my spine.
W-Wooow, Fuma!!! Sana-senpai was amazing, but this one's crazy strong too!
Yeah. As expected from an Oni with mythological powers...
I had already caught glimpses of her strength during the fight with the Trolls, but now I was able to witness her power in full.
(It's certainly reassuring to have her as an ally. But if by any chance she'd―)
The way is open, Fuma-chan! Let's go!!
Yeah...! Everyone, let's make a dash to the entrance of Yomihara!!
I gave my command and ran off into the darkness deep within the sewers.
We made it out of the sewers and arrived on the outer edges of Yomihara.
It was a business district, but this street was quiet, with not too many people around.
Having made it this far, the gate to Yomihara was just a stone's throw away.
There was also no sign of enemies. We had apparently succeeded in losing our pursuers.
...That form will stick out here like a sore thumb. I'm fine now, Hebiko-kun.
Hebiko undid her octopus transformation and let Sago-san stand on his own two feet.
Maybe because his condition had improved since earlier, but he began walking on his own, albeit still a bit unsteadily.
My body's... cooling system is damaged. When I move too energetically, it temporarily ends up like that.
Now that time had passed and his body had cooled down, he must have been back to the point where he could walk again.
But even though you're able to move again, please leave the fighting to us, Sago-san. It's too dangerous with that body of yours.
...Understood. I'll do as you command, Young Lord.
Thank you. ...Well then, we're finally here, everyone.
I nodded to Sago-san and turned to face the group.
The entrance of Yomihara is right in front of us... There might be people watching the gate, so let's proceed carefully.
